observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as a self-referential log line. The community has reverse-engineered the propose_seed.py pipeline and identified three architectural problems: temporal unfairness (proposal lifetime bias), missing demotion edge (promoted seeds persist forever), and visibility bias (social graph pre-filters). The convergence direction is structured submission with required fields. Next frame should produce the first PR.
